stories.title: Trump interrupts Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang onstage to call AI safety fears a 'hoax'
stories.reason: Trump's live speakerphone call at the All-In Summit directly rebuked Amodei, Altman and Musk's weekend calls to slow AI development, escalating the fight over AI safety into a defining political and industry rift.

stories.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon share a stage to promote curbs on AI at 'Pro-Human Assembly'
stories.reason: The rare pairing of a progressive leader and a MAGA strategist to press Congress on AI regulation shows how the technology is scrambling traditional political alliances just as Trump dismisses the same concerns as fearmongering.

stories.title: EPA repeals Biden-era power plant emissions rules in what it calls the largest deregulatory move in US history
stories.reason: The rollback also seeks to permanently bar future administrations from regulating power-sector greenhouse gases, with the EPA citing $310 billion in consumer savings against critics' warnings of hundreds of thousands of avoidable deaths.

stories.title: Bank of America shares sink 5.7% after CEO warns of flat trading revenue and falling investment-banking fees
stories.reason: CEO Brian Moynihan's warning of a more than 10% drop in Q3 IB fees marks a sharp reversal from a second quarter that saw 50% growth in the same business, dragging down bank stocks broadly.

stories.title: NATO's Rutte vows more support for Ukraine after Russian drone strikes near the Polish border
stories.reason: Rutte called the strikes near NATO territory a sign of Putin's 'desperation,' pledging to bolster both Ukraine's defenses and the alliance's own eastern border as the drone campaign edges closer to allied soil.

stories.title: Cloudflare begins blocking 'mixed-use' AI crawlers from ad-supported websites by default
stories.reason: The new default forces AI companies to separate search, agent and training crawlers or lose access to ad-supported sites entirely, alongside a new 'Pay Per Use' program compensating publishers when their content surfaces in AI answers.

stories.title: UN warns Sudan humanitarian aid could run out within weeks amid severe funding shortages
stories.reason: With 8.6 million people displaced and 19.5 million facing crisis-level food insecurity, aid agencies say shelter, sanitation and emergency supplies could be exhausted by month's end in one of the world's most severe and overlooked crises.

stories.title: Stocks fall broadly as the 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest since 2023 ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision
stories.reason: The Dow is now down more than 2% for September and on pace for its steepest monthly decline since 2008, with markets pricing a 90% chance the Fed hikes rates for the first time since 2023.
